current_position: American R&B singer-songwriter with multiple Grammy nominations; released self-titled album Kehlani in 2024; continues touring and releasing music independently.

trajectory.event: Finished fourth on America's Got Talent as lead vocalist of PopLyfe, produced by D'Wayne Wiggins.
Released debut mixtape Cloud 19, ranked #28 on Complex's 50 Best Albums of 2014.
Released You Should Be Here mixtape, debuting at #5 on Billboard Top R&B/Hip-Hop Albums; signed to Atlantic Records; earned Grammy nomination for Best Urban Contemporary Album.
Released debut studio album SweetSexySavage on Atlantic Records.
Released second album It Was Good Until It Wasn't, their highest-charting album.
Released self-titled album Kehlani, continuing their independent music career.
